Hi Nina — great to continue the conversation. Attaching an initial MAP template (MAP_VectorHealth_v1.xlsx) and a short commercial note below to get alignment.

High level commercial approach for Private / VPC:
- Platform fee: one-time platform onboarding fee that covers private control-plane setup and initial security review. Typical range: $40k–$80k depending on region and networking complexity.
- Licensing: recurring usage-based billing (per-token) plus a small per-instance capacity reservation for Dedicated/private deployments.
- Commit tiers & discounting: 3-tier commit structure (Pilot, Growth, Production) with increasing discounts at each tier. We can ladder discounts to achieved throughput / committed spend.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Kickoff & security onboarding — week 0–1 (deliverables: network diagram, access plan)
2) Private preprod deployment + smoke tests — week 1–2 (deliverables: preprod endpoints, sample inference)
3) Eval run & quality checks — week 2–4 (deliverables: evaluation report, regression tests)
4) Commercial sign & production cutover — target by 2026-03-31 (deliverables: signed contract, production SLA)

Next steps:
- Marissa, can you propose committed tiers & discount schedule to share with VectorHealth?
- I'll include SOC2 summary and SOW draft in the next update.

Thanks,
Priyom Das

Hi Nina / Jason — attaching a commercial worksheet and an updated MAP (MAP_VectorHealth_v3.xlsx) that adds a committed spend ladder and suggested discount triggers. Key points up front:

- Pilot pricing (2–4 weeks): minimal platform fee waived for pilots when a 6-month commit is agreed within 30 days of pilot completion.
- Platform fee: one-time onboarding fee proposed at $55,000 for private/VPC (covers dedicated control-plane & concierge onboarding).
- Commit tiers (examples):
  * Pilot: $25k committed spend — no discount; reserved capacity optional
  * Growth: $150k committed over 12 months — 10% discount on per-token rates + 5% rebate if ramp targets met
  * Production: $500k+ committed — 20% discount + quota guarantees / priority scheduling
- Ramp milestones: discounts/rebates tied to MAP milestones (preprod signoff, 30-day production traffic, 90-day throughput).

We included an SOW draft that outlines delivery scope and a proposed payment schedule aligned to MAP milestones (30% onboarding + platform fee on sign, 40% on production cutover, remainder on 30-day SLA acceptance).

Questions for VectorHealth:
- Is the onboarding window of 2 weeks for preprod realistic for your infra team?
- Any internal approval windows in procurement we should align with to hit the Mar 31 target?

Thanks,

Hi Jason / Nina — Vivek from Legal / Security — appreciate the detailed questions. Quick responses and proposed contract language below.

Platform fee line items (we'll add to SOW):
- Control plane provisioning & secure VPN setup — $22,000
- Dedicated onboarding engineering (2 engineers, 2 weeks) — $18,000
- Documentation, runbook, and two on-site/remote enablement sessions — $15,000

We do not bill for cloud infra egress or third-party compute; those remain with VectorHealth unless Redwood is hosting managed infra (not part of this MAP).

Proposed measurable ramp triggers (to include in MAP):
- Preprod signoff: successful execution of 3 smoke tests + security checklist completed (date-stamped).
- Day-30 production threshold: average inference requests/day >= 5k AND 99th percentile latency < 450ms for 30 consecutive days.
- Day-90 SLA: committed throughput >= X tokens/day as noted in the committed tier (we'll replace X with agreed number in final MAP).

Contract clause suggestion for platform fee credit: if VectorHealth signs a 12-month commit within 30 days post-pilot, we will credit 100% of the platform fee against the first 3 months of recurring charges (applied pro rata).

Attached is a short SOC2 summary and redline suggestions for the SOW. If procurement would like, we can provide an attestation letter for data residency controls.

Regards,
